name: ERC Starting Grant 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: For researchers post-PhD (eligibility widened to 10 years from 2027). Up to €1.5M for 5 years. Bottom-up: any research topic. Call opens July 2026, deadline 14 October 2026.

name: EWUU i4PH Seed Call 2026 – Preventive health transitions
themes: Implementation & health services; Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health
partnersNote: At least three co-applicants from at least three EWUU institutions (TU/e, WUR, UU, UMC Utrecht); main applicant postdoc, assistant or associate professor
summary: Seed funding from the TU/e–WUR–UU–UMCU alliance for transdisciplinary preventive-health projects that fit an i4PH research line (healthy start, healthy living environments, future of cancer, health at home) and a transition pathway (incl. 'planetary-centred'). Meant to produce a tangible next step such as a Horizon Europe or NWA application, white paper or review. Total €200k, about 4–5 projects; projects start from 1 Jan 2027 and budget must be spent before 1 Dec 2027.

name: Call for Validation of Biomarker Candidates 2027
themes: Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; Clinical trials & drug development; HTA & health economics
partnersNote: Multidisciplinary consortium of at least 4 participating parties; AI projects must involve AI4Health consortium
summary: Funds multidisciplinary consortia (at least 4 parties, private partners allowed) to clinically validate known cancer biomarkers towards use in daily practice, EUR 0.8-2M per project over 2-5 years. An (early) HTA, biostatistics expertise, a development plan and patient involvement are mandatory. Pre-proposals close 20 Oct 2026 (12:00); full proposals 15 Dec 2026-23 Feb 2027, decision June 2027.

name: KNMP Studentenprijs (annual pharmacy student prize)
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: Nomination by hoogleraar/docent
summary: Annual KNMP prize (certificate plus EUR 1,000) for outstanding master pharmacy students, nominated by their teachers and professors for strong study results and commitment to pharmacy education and the profession. Six winners in 2025, awarded at the KNMP Najaarscongres in late October (the 2026 congress is on 27 October 2026). No public nomination deadline is published, as nominations come from faculty. The date shown is the award ceremony (latest possible), not a published nomination deadline.

name: COST Open Call OC-2026-1 – New COST Actions (research networks)
themes: Open (any discipline); Education & training
partnersNote: Network of at least 7 COST Full/Cooperating Members, at least 50% from Inclusiveness Target Countries; at least 40% Young Researchers and Innovators.
summary: Bottom-up call for new COST Actions, European science and technology networks that fund meetings, short-term scientific missions, training schools and dissemination, not the research itself. A proposal needs at least seven COST member countries, at least half of them Inclusiveness Target Countries, and at least 40% young researchers. Up to 80 Actions may be approved. The collection date is 28 October 2026, 12:00 CET.

name: PhRMA Foundation – Value Assessment & Health Outcomes Research Pre- & Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
themes: HTA & health economics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Pharmaceutical policy & access; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
partnersNote: Applicant must be based at an accredited US university (US and non-US citizens eligible)
summary: PhRMA Foundation fellowships in value assessment and health outcomes research: postdoctoral USD 60,000/yr and predoctoral USD 30,000/yr stipend, for 12-24 months. The 2027 postdoctoral cycle opened 31 August 2026 and closes 30 October 2026 (noon ET); awards announced March 2027. The predoctoral page still shows the 2026 cycle (deadline was 30 Oct 2025) and says the 2027 cycle launches soon. Applicants must be at an accredited US university, so mainly relevant for US-based collaborators.

name: Sustainability Education Community Fund (UU)
careerStages: Master; PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health; Education & training
partnersNote: Main applicant must be a UU employee or student
summary: Small grants for bottom-up sustainability-education initiatives at UU such as workshops, seminars and pilots; covers assistance and material costs (incl. travel and events), not teaching-hour reductions. €12,500 available in this round; decisions 6–8 weeks after the deadline.

name: Vidi – Science Domain 2026
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Open (any discipline)
summary: NWO Vidi for researchers moving into leadership who obtained their PhD within eight years before 1 October 2026 (extensions possible). Up to EUR 850,000 for up to five years to build a research line and group; requires an embedding guarantee from a Dutch host institution. Science-domain pre-proposals are due 3 November 2026, 14:00 CET; invited full proposals are due 6 April 2027, 14:00 CEST.

name: Exploration Call 2027-1
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: KWF project call for basic and credentialing research into the biological and psychosocial mechanisms behind cancer onset, growth, spread and impact; relevant for mechanistic work on anticancer drugs. Call 2027-1 accepts pre-proposals from 1 September to 3 November 2026 (12:00); invited full proposals run 15 February to 13 April 2027, with interviews in June and decisions in August 2027. KWF describes this as its last project-based basic-research call before switching to research group funding from 2028.

name: International Joint Initiative 2026 – Disruptive Technologies for Global Challenges
themes: Data science & AI; Global health; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 2 countries from participating funders: NWO, NFRF-Canada, NordForsk, Research Ireland, UKRI, etc.)
summary: International call (NWO with NFRF and other funders) for interdisciplinary consortia of at least three PIs funded by different participating agencies, using disruptive technologies to address the SDGs. NWO funding is limited to projects on SDG 2, 6, 7 or 11 and is max EUR 760,000 per project; the NWO budget was raised to EUR 6.84M in August 2026. LOIs were due 9 June 2026; only invited applicants can now submit full proposals by 3 November 2026 (NFRF portal), with NWO's ISAAC part due 4 November 2026, 14:00 CET.

name: Vidi – ZonMw Health Research and Medical Sciences Domain 2026
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Open (any discipline)
summary: 2026 Vidi round for the ZonMw Health Research and Medical Sciences domain, aimed at researchers moving into a leadership role who obtained their PhD within eight years of 1 October 2026. Up to €850,000 for a project of up to five years. Two-stage: pre-proposals due 3 November 2026 (14:00 CET); invited applicants submit full proposals by 6 April 2027 (14:00 CEST). Applications go through Mijn ZonMw and need a dean-signed embedding guarantee.

name: KIC Demand-driven Research by Consortia – XL
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Pharmaceutical policy & access; HTA & health economics
partnersNote: Consortium required: knowledge institutions + societal/industry partners (co-funding needed)
summary: NWO KIC call for large public-private consortia tackling societal challenges, with NWO funding EUR 1.4M-7M per proposal (up to 70% of costs) for up to six years and a EUR 14M call ceiling. At least 30% co-funding is required, part of it private cash. The mandatory pre-proposal deadline was 10 March 2026; full proposals are due 12 November 2026, 14:00 CET (only for those who submitted a pre-proposal).

name: SME Call 2027 (MKB Call)
themes: Open (any discipline); Valorisation & public-private; Clinical trials & drug development
partnersNote: Public-private partnership with SME required
summary: Health~Holland call for public-private R&D projects between SMEs and research organisations (industrial research, TRL 4-6, max 2 years). Consortia can request EUR 225,000-450,000 in PPP subsidy (research organisations max EUR 150,000 per project), at least EUR 8M total for about 20 projects. The lead applicant must be a Dutch for-profit company, and all partners must co-finance. Full applications are due 20 November 2026, 17:00 CET.

name: Applied Data Science (ADS) Research Grants – autumn 2026 round
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Data science & AI; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Interfaculty collaboration expected (UU/UMCU)
summary: The UU focus area Applied Data Science funds small interfaculty projects of up to €5,000 that apply or develop data science methods. It also funds seed money for preparing interdisciplinary grant applications and consultation costs when a data scientist from another faculty helps. UU and UMC Utrecht researchers are eligible. Calls have run about twice a year (May/June and November; the last form was dated 22 November 2025), but the next date is not published.

name: CARB-X 2026 Funding Round 2 – Antibacterial Research (all themes)
themes: Antimicrobial resistance & One Health; Clinical trials & drug development; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: CARB-X's second 2026 funding round accepts expressions of interest from 10 to 23 November 2026 across all four 2026 themes: direct-acting therapeutics for Gram-negative infections, the Novel Chemistry for AMR Challenge (target-based therapeutics), non-vaccine prevention of neonatal sepsis, and neonatal sepsis diagnostics. Successful applicants must cover part of the project cost. Funding amounts per award are not stated on the application page.

name: MSCA Doctoral Networks 2026
themes: Education & training; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
partnersNote: Network of min. 3 organisations from 3 different countries required
summary: OPEN. MSCA Doctoral Networks call HORIZON-MSCA-2026-DN-01 funds international doctoral training networks with 3-year PhD positions and mobility. Opened 28 May 2026; deadline 24 November 2026 (17:00 Brussels). Indicative call budget EUR 593.03M (over 130 projects expected). The division already runs the EU2P programme.

name: Utrechts Universiteitsfonds – Funding for researchers (round 6, 2026)
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: Grants for UU employees for research visits abroad and for research and education costs (e.g. hiring help, materials, organising a congress), applied for through the UU subsidy portal. Six rounds per year; not every fund type is open in every round, and each fund has its own criteria.

name: Utrechts Universiteitsfonds – Student support (international exchange/internship), round 6 2026
themes: Education & training; Open (any discipline)
summary: The Utrecht University Fund's student programme helps fund an international exchange or internship, for example a master's research internship abroad. Applicants must be a Student Friend of the Fund (€10 a year). Named funds within the Fund may set their own criteria. About €80,000 a year is available across all student grants. In 2026 there are six rounds, and round 6 runs from 2 to 27 November 2026.

name: KNMP Zorginnovatieprijs 2027
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Implementation & health services; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
partnersNote: Entrant must be a KNMP member
summary: Annual KNMP prize of €10,000 plus a certificate for an innovation in pharmacist care that is not yet standard or widely implemented. The jury scores relative advantage, compatibility, reduced complexity, testability and visibility; finalists then go to a member vote, and the prize is presented at the KNMP Voorjaarscongres. Only KNMP members (community and hospital pharmacists) can enter. For the 2026 edition, entries opened around 30 September and closed around 28 November (week 48), so the 2027 dates shown are estimated.

name: Rubicon 2026-3 (postdoc research abroad)
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: Lets recent PhD graduates (PhD within 12 months before the deadline, or a supervisor's declaration that the thesis is approved) spend 12–24 months at a research institute outside the Netherlands. It covers salary, travel and limited research costs; the round budget of €3,145,000 is shared across the four NWO domains. Applications are individual and due 1 December 2026, 14:00.

name: GGG – Alledaagse Aandoeningen in de huisartsenpraktijk (Common Conditions in General Practice)
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Clinical trials & drug development; Implementation & health services
partnersNote: Applicant must participate in UNH-Research via a university general-practice department (e.g. partner with a GP department such as UMC Utrecht/Julius Center).
summary: Good Use of Medicines (GGG) round for research on questions from the NHG general-practice knowledge agenda, aiming at more effective, safer or more efficient use of medicines already registered in the Netherlands for common conditions. Total budget is €5 million with no fixed cap per project; multicentre studies may be needed. Project ideas are due 7 December 2026; invited full applications are due 31 May 2027, with a decision expected end of October 2027. The applicant must take part in UNH-Research through a university general-practice department.

name: Prix Galien Research Award Nederland 2027
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Clinical trials & drug development
summary: Dutch prize (gold medal) for a promising early-career researcher without an ordinary chair whose pharmacological research programme at a Dutch institution clearly exceeds PhD level; self-nomination needs a third-party recommendation. The 2027 cycle has not been announced; in the most recent published rules registration closed 13 Dec 2024 with dossiers due 7 Mar 2025, so the date shown is a projection and not confirmed.

name: Geneesmiddelen VIMP 2026-1 (Dissemination & Implementation Impulse)
themes: Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Implementation & health services; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: VIMP (dissemination and implementation boost) within ZonMw's Goed Gebruik Geneesmiddelen programme, helping finished ZonMw-funded research on good medicine use (completed no more than three years ago) get used in practice; dissemination alone is not enough. Max EUR 50,000 and 18 months per project from a EUR 250,000 budget; open since 22 June 2026, deadline 22 December 2026, 14:00, though it may close earlier if the budget runs out. Applicant must be a legal entity in the Netherlands, and applications are in Dutch.

name: KNMP Stipendiafonds (international study trip grant)
themes: Education & training
summary: KNMP stipend for pharmacy students at Groningen, Leiden and Utrecht who go abroad for at least two weeks for research that is part of their pharmacy study; applicant must be a candidate KNMP member and must not have started the research yet. Applications are judged three times a year (closing dates 1 January, 1 July and 1 October). A 'light' application gives EUR 300-500; a 'heavy' application (meeting at least two high-potential criteria) can give a higher, unspecified amount. Each student may apply only once.

name: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027 for researchers 5-15 years after their PhD (extensions possible for e.g. parental leave). Up to EUR 2M for 5 years, plus up to EUR 1M extra for justified costs. Bottom-up, any research topic. The call opened 24 September 2026 and closes 12 January 2027.

name: Open Competition Domain Science – XS 2027 (Packet 27-1)
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: Small grants (up to EUR 50k, up to 1 year in previous rounds) for promising, speculative ideas in the NWO Science domain, assessed in three packets per year. The 2026 call had packets closing 13 Jan, 14 Apr and 15 Sep 2026. A 2027 call has not been announced; the date shown is projected from packet 26-1 and is not confirmed.

name: KHMW Proefschriftprijs Interdisciplinariteit 2027
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: KHMW prize of EUR 10,000 (funded by the ESM Foundation) for one strongly interdisciplinary PhD thesis bridging the natural, social and humanities sciences, researched at a Dutch institution. The 2027 edition is for defences between 1 September 2025 and 31 August 2026. KHMW will open nominations in November 2026; the deadline is not yet published (the previous one was 15 January).

name: SSH Open Competition XS (Explore) 2027 – Round 1
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; HTA & health economics; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: Small NWO grants (up to EUR 50k in 2026 rounds) for innovative social sciences and humanities research. NWO pre-announced three XS rounds in 2027 with deadlines expected in January, April and September, and from 2027 researchers can apply directly after their PhD; one application per calendar year across the SSH Open Competition. Exact round-1 date not confirmed; date shown is projected from 2026 round 1 (20 Jan 2026).

name: Veni – ZonMw Health Research Domain 2026/2027
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Open (any discipline)
summary: NWO Veni in the ZonMw Health Research and Development domain: up to EUR 320,000 for up to three years for researchers with a PhD obtained within three years before 1 January 2026 (or between 1 January and 2 September 2026). The pre-proposal deadline was 1 September 2026 and no new applications are possible. Applicants with a positive pre-proposal decision submit full proposals by 26 January 2027, 14:00 CET.

name: ERA4Health IICS4all 2027 (JTC9) – Investigator-Initiated Clinical Studies in Cardiovascular, Autoimmune, Metabolic & Respiratory Diseases
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Implementation & health services
diseaseAreas: Cardiovascular; Diabetes & metabolic; Rheumatology & immunology; Respiratory
partnersNote: Multinational consortium; participating funders listed in pre-announcement (no Dutch funder)
summary: ERA4Health's ninth joint transnational call will fund pragmatic, multinational phase III randomised investigator-initiated studies, either comparative-effectiveness trials or repurposing of off-patent drugs, in cardiovascular, metabolic, autoimmune and non-communicable respiratory diseases, with attention to diverse and underrepresented populations (up to 48 months). The pre-announcement says the call will be published on 27 October 2026; budget and deadlines are not yet public. The Netherlands/ZonMw is not among the expected funders, so Dutch teams should check the call text on how they can take part. The deadline shown is an estimate (Trials4Health 2026 pre-proposal date + 1 year).

name: KNAW Early Career Partnerships 2026
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: KNAW Early Career Partnerships: EUR 10,000 to organise an interdisciplinary science meeting, for researchers 3-7 years post-PhD at a Dutch university or research institute (KNAW extension rules apply). Up to ten partnerships per year. The next round opens on 1 November 2026; the closing date is not yet published (the 2026 round closed in early February).

name: Dekker Grants 2027 (Postdoc, Senior Scientist, Clinical Scientist)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Four Dekker grant types were open: Postdoc (3 positions, 2-3 years), Senior Scientist, Clinical Scientist, and Senior Clinical Scientist. External submission deadline was 3 February 2026 14:00. Monitor for 2027 round opening ~Dec 2026.

name: EUP OHAMR 2nd Joint Transnational Call – Preventing Emergence & Spread of AMR
themes: Antimicrobial resistance & One Health; Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Transnational consortium across multiple partner countries; national funding via participating agencies (e.g. ZonMw for NL)
summary: The European Partnership on One Health AMR (EUP OHAMR) runs joint transnational calls with national funders (e.g. ZonMw for NL). Its first call (JTC 2026, treatments and adherence to treatment protocols; over EUR 31M from 37 funders in 28 countries) opened 18 November 2025, with pre-proposals due 2 February 2026 and full proposals 17 June 2026. A second call has not yet been announced on ohamr.eu; the deadline shown is a placeholder based on the first call's timing. Relevant for antimicrobial stewardship, adherence and drug-utilisation research.

name: THCS Joint Transnational Call 2027 (Transforming Health and Care Systems, expected)
funder: THCS Partnership (Transforming Health and Care Systems)
themes: Implementation & health services; HTA & health economics; Pharmaceutical policy & access
partnersNote: Transnational consortium with partners from several participating countries.
summary: The Horizon Europe co-funded THCS partnership has run a joint transnational call every year (2023 Healthcare of the Future, 2024 Innovate to Prevent, 2025 Better care closer to home, 2026 Access to Care). ZonMw, NWO and NIVEL are Dutch partners. A 2027 call has not been announced. The 2026 call opened in November 2025, with pre-proposals due 2 February 2026 and full proposals due 30 June 2026; the date here is an estimate based on that pattern.

name: EP PerMed Joint Transnational Call 2027 (JTC2027)
themes: Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Data science & AI
partnersNote: Multinational consortium across participating EP PerMed countries
summary: EP PerMed runs a yearly joint transnational call for multinational personalised medicine projects; the 2026 call (CARMEN2026, about EUR 38M, ZonMw participating) was published in late November 2025. No 2027 call has been announced yet. EP PerMed says it has no information on upcoming calls, so the topic, budget and dates are not known. The deadline shown is an estimate (JTC2026 pre-proposal date of 10 Feb + 1 year).

name: Erasmus+ Capacity Building in Higher Education 2027
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Education & training; Global health
partnersNote: International consortium with partners from eligible programme and partner countries
summary: Erasmus+ CBHE funds international consortia that modernise higher education in partner countries, which could suit pharmacy and pharmacoepidemiology education projects. In the 2026 call there were three strands, with grants from EUR 200k (Strand 1) up to EUR 1M (Strand 3), and the deadline was 10 February 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time. The 2027 call has not been published yet. The deadline shown is an estimate (2026 date + 1 year).

name: NVKFB Proefschriftprijs (clinical pharmacology dissertation)
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Clinical trials & drug development
partnersNote: NVKFB membership required
summary: EUR 1,000 annual NVKFB prize for a dissertation on clinical pharmacological or biopharmaceutical research from a university in the Dutch-language region, by an NVKFB member (self-nomination allowed). The promotion may be at most three years before the award, and a candidate can be nominated only once. Submit the thesis PDF to info@nvkfb.nl; the current reglement (May 2026) states no deadline, and the next round is expected around mid-February 2027.

name: NVKFB TOP-Publicatieprijs (best clinical pharmacology publication)
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Education & training
partnersNote: NVKFB membership required
summary: EUR 500 educational grant awarded each year by the NVKFB for the best original clinical pharmacology article (English or Dutch, peer-reviewed) published in the previous calendar year with an NVKFB member working in the Dutch-speaking region as first author. One submission per member per year; reviews, editorials and abstracts are excluded. NVKFB sends members a yearly call; no deadline is published yet (expected around February 2027).

name: ERDERA Joint Transnational Call 2027 (expected)
themes: Rare diseases & orphan drugs; Clinical trials & drug development; Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics
partnersNote: Multinational consortium (several countries); check 2027 call text
summary: ERDERA, the European Rare Diseases Research Alliance, runs a yearly two-stage joint transnational call for multinational rare-disease research consortia. The 2027 topic and dates have not been published. The pre-proposal deadline shown is an estimate from the 2026 JTC (pre-proposals 12 February, full proposals 8 July 2026). ERDERA's separate 2026 Clinical Trial Call is open but required an expression of interest by 10 September 2026.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027 Adverse Drug Reactions – Personalised Approaches
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 countries)
summary: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-CARE-02 (RIA, single stage): personalised approaches to reduce adverse drug reactions in patients taking three or more medicines, especially with comorbidities. Proposals should combine pharmacogenomics and other biomarkers for stratification with EHRs, AI and clinical decision support, assess clinical utility and cost-effectiveness, and feed results into EMA and national (de)prescribing guidance. EUR 38M for about 4 projects of EUR 8-10M. Highly relevant for PECP. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage – AI for Predictive Biomarkers in Chronic NCDs
themes: Data science & AI; Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; Implementation & health services; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: International consortium, min. 3 entities from 3 EU/associated countries
summary: Horizon Europe two-stage RIA HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage: developing predictive biomarkers of disease progression and treatment response with AI methods for chronic non-communicable diseases. EUR 44.2M for about 6 projects of EUR 6-8M. Opens 29 October 2026; first-stage deadline 17 February 2027, second-stage deadline 16 September 2027. Highly relevant for the division's AI/data science and pharmacoepi work.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-08 – New Antibacterial & Antifungal Therapies
themes: Antimicrobial resistance & One Health; Clinical trials & drug development; Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)
summary: Horizon Europe RIA HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-08 for innovative antimicrobials against resistant pathogens; each proposal targets one of CRAB, CRE/third-generation cephalosporin-resistant Enterobacterales, carbapenem-resistant P. aeruginosa, MRSA, drug-resistant Aspergillus fumigatus or drug-resistant Candida. Phage therapies are out of scope. EUR 44.2M for about 5 projects of EUR 8-10M. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-ENVHLTH-02 – Climate-related Exposures in the Human Exposome
themes: Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Data science & AI
partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)
summary: Horizon Europe RIA (call HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01, single stage) on integrating climate-related exposures such as heat, air pollution and drought into large human exposome studies and modelling how the exposome shifts under climate change. Projects should use AI and real-world data, address social and demographic vulnerability, include social sciences and humanities, and share outputs via IHEN platforms and the European Climate and Health Observatory. EUR 45M for about 4 projects of EUR 10-11M. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-05/06/07 – Antivirals & Monoclonal Antibodies
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: International consortium required (min. 3 entities, 3 EU/associated countries)
summary: Three single-stage RIA topics in call HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01: DISEASE-05 novel small-molecule antivirals for pathogens with epidemic potential (EUR 44.2M, ~5 projects of EUR 9-11M; one of six named virus groups, antibodies excluded), DISEASE-06 monoclonal antibodies against flaviviruses and DISEASE-07 monoclonal antibodies against filo-, nairo-, phenui-, picorna- and togaviruses (each EUR 37.3M, ~4 projects of EUR 9-10M). Work runs from discovery to GMP batches and first-in-human safety studies. Relevant mainly as a partner for clinical pharmacology and safety work packages. Dates conflict: the 2026-2027 work programme gives 17 February 2027 as the deadline, while the Funding & Tenders portal currently shows 10 February–13 April 2027; the earlier date is shown here until the portal settles.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-DISEASE-01 – Innovative Healthcare Interventions for Non-Communicable Diseases (two-stage)
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; HTA & health economics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Standard Horizon Europe consortium (at least 3 independent entities from 3 EU/associated countries); SSH expertise required.
summary: Research and Innovation Action funding early-stage (phase 1/2 for drugs) clinical trials of new or refined pharmacological or non-pharmacological interventions for cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic respiratory disease or chronic kidney disease. Applicants need prior proof-of-concept and a draft protocol, plus a health-economic assessment and real-world data analysis; comparative-effectiveness studies are out of scope. Expected EU contribution is €7–8 million per project (about 8 projects). The call opens 29 October 2026, with the first stage due 17 February 2027 and the second stage due 16 September 2027. The Funding & Tenders portal shows different (later) dates for some 2027 health topics than the work programme; check the portal before planning.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-DISEASE-10 – Chronic NCDs in Children and Young People (GACD implementation research)
themes: Global health; Implementation & health services
partnersNote: Equitable partnership and shared leadership between HIC and LMIC (and/or Indigenous) members; at least one early-career co-investigator.
summary: Implementation research on preventing, screening, diagnosing and managing chronic non-communicable diseases in people aged 1–24 in low- and middle-income countries and/or underserved high-income populations, aligned with the 12th Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases call. Projects must use hybrid effectiveness-implementation designs and equitable HIC–LMIC leadership; pharmacological trials and aetiological cohorts are excluded. Expected EU contribution is €3–4 million per project (about 3 projects). The single-stage call opens 29 October 2026 and closes 17 February 2027. The Funding & Tenders portal shows different (later) dates for some 2027 health topics than the work programme; check the portal before planning.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-DISEASE-14 – Clinical Trials for Neurodegenerative Diseases (two-stage)
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
partnersNote: Standard Horizon Europe consortium (at least 3 entities from 3 EU/associated countries).
summary: Research and Innovation Action for clinical trials that advance innovative interventions for neurodegenerative diseases. Expected EU contribution is around €10 million per project (about 4 projects). The call opens 29 October 2026, with the first stage due 17 February 2027 and the second stage due 16 September 2027. The detailed topic scope was not read, so check the work programme. summary: Second 2026 Exploration call for fundamental cancer research. Young Investigator Grant (YIG) proposals must now be submitted under a separate call. Exploration Call 2026-1 closed 1 May 2026 (see ID 74). Relevant for pharmacoepi research on anticancer drug safety.

name: ERC Plus Grant 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: Second round of the ERC Plus Grant: up to €7M per project for transformative, high-ambition research, open to PIs at any career stage. ERC Work Programme 2027 gives ERC-2027-PLUS a provisional opening of 1 June 2027 and a deadline of 1 September 2027, with a budget of €210M and about 30 grants.

name: EU4Health 2027 Work Programme – Action Grants incl. Conference Grants (expected)
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Implementation & health services; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: The Commission is preparing the EU4Health 2027 work programme, the last under the 2021-2027 programme. A targeted consultation ran until 12 June 2026 around five strands: crisis preparedness, health promotion and prevention, health systems and workforce, digital transformation, and cancer, cardiovascular and other NCDs. Calls, including the recurring high-level conference grants, are expected in 2027. No calls or dates are published yet, so the deadline is an estimate.

name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: Annual MSCA call for individual European and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships for researchers with a PhD, under the MSCA 2026-2027 work programme. A draft of that work programme (Nov 2025) lists HORIZON-MSCA-2027-PF-01 as opening 7 April 2027 with a deadline of 8 September 2027 and about €389M indicative budget. These dates are not yet confirmed on an official call page.

name: GGG – Goed Gebruik Geneesmiddelen Open Ronde 17 (2027)
themes: Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Medication adherence & self-management
partnersNote: Collaboration with patient representatives, healthcare professionals and/or insurers expected (per previous rounds)
summary: Open round of ZonMw's Good Use of Medicines programme, funding research on better, safer and more efficient medicine use. Open Ronde 16 had EUR 6M in total and up to EUR 1.5M per project, with a project-idea deadline of 14 Sep 2026 and full proposals on 2 Mar 2027. A next open round has not been announced; the project-idea deadline shown is projected (previous + 1 year) and is not confirmed.

name: Open Competition Domain Science – XL 2027/2028 (expected)
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Data science & AI
partnersNote: Consortium project
summary: NWO's Domain Science XL call for large consortium projects across all Domain Science disciplines, including Life Sciences. NWO says the call runs once every two years, and the 2025/2026 round had a pre-proposal deadline of 16 September 2025. The next round has not been announced, so the pre-proposal deadline is estimated two years after the last one and is not confirmed. The budget range shown comes from the previous round.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-04 – Virtual Human Twins for Clinical Decision Support in Prevention and Diagnosis
themes: Data science & AI; Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; HTA & health economics
diseaseAreas: Cardiovascular; Oncology; Diabetes & metabolic; Infectious disease
partnersNote: Multidisciplinary consortium; SSH contribution mandatory; SME participation encouraged.
summary: Research and Innovation Action to build and clinically validate multi-scale, patient-specific Virtual Human Twin models that support prevention and diagnosis, including health-economic or cost-effectiveness evidence from real-world settings and plans for regulatory compliance (MDR/IVDR, AI Act). Expected EU contribution is €10–12 million per project (about 4 projects). The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-08 – Next Generation of Frontier AI Models for Healthcare (CSA)
themes: Data science & AI
partnersNote: Horizon Europe CSA consortium.
summary: Coordination and Support Action (a single project of around €2.9 million) on preparing the next generation of frontier AI models for healthcare. The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027. The detailed scope was not read, so check the work programme.

name: Mission Cancer 2027 – CANCER-04 Health-Economics, Health-Systems & Outcomes Research for Equitable Cancer Outcomes
themes: HTA & health economics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Implementation & health services; Pharmaceutical policy & access
partnersNote: Horizon Europe consortium; must build on Knowledge Centre on Cancer resources (ECIS, Cancer Inequalities Registry).
summary: Research and Innovation Action (HORIZON-MISS-2027-02-CANCER-04) to develop health-economics, health-systems, epidemiological and outcomes-research methods for cancer. Funded work covers cost-effectiveness modelling, cancer-control spending linked to value-based care, inequalities, and better access to cost-effective programmes. Expected EU contribution is €5–7 million per project (about 3 projects). The call opens 10 February 2027 with a deadline of 16 September 2027 (FFG lists 15 September), and projects must join the Mission's 'Understanding' cluster.

name: Dr. Saal van Zwanenberg Afstudeerprijzen 2027 (pharmaceutical master thesis)
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Education & training
partnersNote: Nomination (voordracht) required
summary: Three annual KHMW prizes (EUR 3,000 / 2,000 / 1,000) for the best master research reports in pharmaceutical and/or medical sciences in which medicines are central, for graduates of Dutch research universities. Entries are submitted as nominations via the KHMW prize portal. The current round closed 17 Sep 2026; the next date shown is projected (+1 year) and not confirmed.

name: Leopold Meijler Prijs 2027 (best student thesis – drug safety)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Education & training
summary: Annual prize (cash amount plus a ceramic artwork) for the best bachelor's or master's thesis or article on medication safety by a Medicine, Pharmacy or Health Sciences student at a Dutch university. Submissions go by e-mail to Lareb before 1 October; the 2027 edition has not been separately announced, so the date is based on this standing annual deadline.

name: Young Investigator Grant (YIG) Call 2028
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical trials & drug development
summary: Annual KWF call for early-career cancer researchers (PhD at most 5 years before the deadline) to start an independent research line, with up to EUR 1M per project (about 4 years). The 2028 round has not been announced yet; the deadline shown is projected from the 2027 round (pre-proposal 6 Oct 2026, full proposal 1 Apr 2027) and is not confirmed.

name: NWA-ORC 2027 – Research along Routes by Consortia
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Implementation & health services; HTA & health economics; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: Inter- and transdisciplinary consortium incl. societal (public/private) partners; workshop participation required in 2026 round
summary: Dutch Research Agenda (NWA) call for large inter- and transdisciplinary consortia with societal partners tackling NWA questions; the 2026 round had EUR 87M in total and up to EUR 7.25M per proposal for 4-8 years, with mandatory workshops beforehand. A 2027 round has not been announced; the deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (6 Oct 2026) and is not confirmed.

name: WHO Consultancy & Research Contracts
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Global health
summary: WHO regularly commissions research on access to medicines, pharmaceutical policy, essential medicines lists, and regulatory systems. The division already has WHO CC status. Check WHO procurement portal.

name: EMA Framework Contracts & Tenders
themes: Regulatory science; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: EMA publishes calls for tenders on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal and in the Official Journal (TED); open procedures are used from about EUR 140,000, smaller contracts via negotiated procedures. The division already has a framework contract with EMA. Monitor the EMA procurement page for new tenders and ex ante notices.

name: ISPE Research Grants & Awards
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: Various awards and grants including the Distinguished Researcher Award, student awards, and research funding. Directly in the core discipline of the division.

name: FIP Research & Education Grants
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Pharmaceutical policy & access; Education & training
summary: FIP offers various grants for pharmacy practice and education research. The division has MoU with FIP. Monitor FIP website for specific calls.

name: Grand Challenges – Global Health
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Global health; Pharmaceutical policy & access
summary: Various calls for innovative solutions to global health challenges. Relevant for division's work on access to medicines in LMICs and global pharmaceutical policy.

name: ZIN Research Commissions & Collaboration
themes: HTA & health economics; Pharmaceutical policy & access; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy
summary: ZIN (Dutch Healthcare Institute) commissions research to support its HTA and reimbursement decisions. The division already has a relationship with ZIN. Monitor their procurement and research calls for HTA, cost-effectiveness, and formulary research.

name: MEB Research Commissions
themes: Regulatory science; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Pharmaceutical policy & access
summary: The Dutch Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG/MEB) occasionally commissions research related to regulatory science, pharmacovigilance, post-market surveillance, and real-world evidence. Division already has MEB relationship. Monitor Dutch government tender portal (TenderNed).

name: PPP Allowance (Match Call) 2026
themes: Open (any discipline); Clinical trials & drug development; Valorisation & public-private; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Public-private partnership required; company must contribute in-kind
summary: TKI PPP Allowance for LSH projects. Matches private in-kind contributions with public funding. Lower threshold than other Health~Holland calls. Good entry point for industry-academic pharmacoepi collaborations.

name: Climate and Health Award – Mitigation Solutions in LMICs
themes: Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health; Global health
summary: Wellcome scheme advancing climate mitigation solutions with health co-benefits in LMICs. Complements the Climate Impacts Awards. Relevant for sustainable pharmacy research on environmental impact of pharmaceuticals and green healthcare systems.

name: Scientific Meetings and Consultations 2026
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Open (any discipline)
summary: Up to €15,000 for scientific meetings or €2,400 for consultations. Rolling submission (≥6 months before event). Open to researchers with a doctorate, postdocs and PhD candidates in earth/environmental sciences, astronomy, chemistry, computer science, life sciences, physics, mathematics. New conditions from Jan 2026. Good for hosting pharmacoepi workshops/symposia.

name: Philanthropic Partnership – AI in Health (Country-Led Research)
themes: Data science & AI; Global health; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: New $300M global health R&D partnership between Gates Foundation, Novo Nordisk Foundation, and Wellcome. Includes country-led research to guide the use of AI in health. Relevant for division's AI/data science work in pharmacoepidemiology, drug safety signal detection, and real-world evidence generation. Monitor for specific calls as they are announced.

name: EU4Health 2026 Work Programme – Upcoming Action Grants
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; HTA & health economics; Data science & AI
partnersNote: Eligible entities from EU member states or associated countries
summary: EU4Health 2026 Work Programme includes multiple action grants expected to open throughout 2026. Previous topics included AI/health data for CVD (closed Jan 2026) and medicines pricing tracker. New 2026 WP topics in development. 13 EU Member States calling for reinstated civil society operating grants. Monitor HaDEA portal for new calls as they are published.

name: Wellcome Open Research Fund 2026
themes: Open (any discipline); Data science & AI; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Wellcome Open Research Fund supports researchers to develop and test incentives for making health research more open, accessible and reusable. Relevant for division's work on open-source pharmacoepidemiology methods, data sharing frameworks, and reproducible research practices.

name: Wellcome Career Development Awards – Round 3 2026
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: Third 2026 round of Wellcome Career Development Awards. Deadline 24 November 2026. For mid-career researchers establishing independent programmes. Up to 8 years funding. Round 2 deadline 28 July 2026 (see ID 91). UPDATE (Sep 2026): from 25 August 2026 the Career Development Awards scheme moved to an always-open, rolling model with no fixed submission deadlines — apply at any time; proposals are considered at scheduled shortlisting/interview meetings.

name: KNMP Proefschrift-bijdrage (dissertation publication contribution)
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy
summary: KNMP supports 15–25 PhD candidates annually with a contribution toward publication costs of their dissertation and for publishing the main findings in the Pharmaceutisch Weekblad. Aimed at pharmacy-related doctorates. Apply via the KNMP fondsen route.

name: Leopold Meijler Fonds – PhD Dissertation Support (Drug Safety)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: The Leopold Meijler Fonds (housed at Lareb) also supports financing of PhD dissertations in the field of drug safety and medication surveillance, beyond the annual student thesis prize (ID 152). Contact Lareb for eligibility. Relevant for PhD candidates writing dissertations on pharmacovigilance topics.

name: KNMP Fondsen – Onderzoek voor de Apotheker in de Praktijk
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Medication adherence & self-management
summary: KNMP Foundation Funds support small-scale research directly relevant to pharmacist practice. Assessment 3x per year. Applicants should be connected to pharmacy practice. Separate from the Stipendiafonds and PRISMA prize. Good for pilot studies in community/hospital pharmacy practice research.

name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards – Round 3 2026
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: Third 2026 round of Wellcome Early-Career Awards. Deadline 10 November 2026 (confirmed via Wellcome scheme deadline schedule). For early-career researchers developing their research identity. Salary + up to £400,000 research expenses. Round 2 deadline 21 July 2026 (see ID 90). UPDATE (Sep 2026): from 25 August 2026 the Early-Career Awards scheme moved to an always-open, rolling model with no fixed submission deadlines — apply at any time; proposals are considered at scheduled shortlisting/interview meetings.

name: Clinical Trial Program – Cardiovascular Clinical Trials
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Hartstichting Clinical Trial Program for investigator-initiated cardiovascular clinical trials. Maximum 7-year duration. Pre-application submitted via email to research@hartstichting.nl; assessed by programme committee before invitation to full application. Two rounds per year. Relevant for pharmacoepi research on cardiovascular drug outcomes and safety.

name: Wellcome Discovery Awards – Always-Open (rolling)
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Global health; Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health
summary: From 23 September 2026 the Wellcome Discovery Awards scheme becomes always-open with no submission deadlines (replacing the twice-yearly fixed rounds). Supports established researchers and teams pursuing bold, creative research related to human life, health and wellbeing; average award ~GBP 3.5M for up to 8 years. From 29 October 2026 lead applicants must be based at eligible administering organisations in the UK or in low- and middle-income countries in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia. Confirm current eligibility and application route on the scheme page before applying.

name: GCRFF Multinational Clinical Trials Initiative – 2027 EOI rounds
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Multinational consortium across GCRFF partner countries; Hartstichting seeks co-funders
summary: Expression-of-interest route through which cardiovascular research funders of the Global Cardiovascular Research Funders Forum co-fund large multinational clinical trials; Dutch applicants first consult the Hartstichting and submit a pre-application form, then an EOI via the BHF grants system. Hartstichting lists it as continuously open with two rounds per year (2025 rounds: 23 May and 26 Sep); 2027 round dates are not published.

name: Netwerkactiviteitenregeling (network events funding)
themes: Valorisation & public-private; Education & training
partnersNote: Substantial SME participation and co-funding from other parties required.
summary: Contributes to the third-party costs (such as venue and catering) of national or international events that connect researchers, companies, care professionals and investors in the Dutch life sciences and health sector. Events must involve SMEs substantially, fit the Health & Care missions and have other co-funders; flights and hotels are not covered. Applications go in at least four months before the event, and a committee reviews them every two weeks.

name: ERDERA Networking Support Scheme (rare disease networking events)
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Rare diseases & orphan drugs
partnersNote: 3–10 co-applicants from at least 3 ERDERA countries, at least one from an underrepresented country.
summary: Funds transnational networking events, in person or hybrid, on rare diseases or rare cancers, bringing together researchers, clinicians and patient organisations. It pays up to €30,000 per event, including participants' travel and accommodation. Groups of 3–10 co-applicants from at least three countries apply, including at least one from an underrepresented country. Rounds are collected every six months while funds last (expected until April 2029), but the page does not give the next collection date.
